## Summary

The problem statement defines:

**Core Problem**: TeamBot users have no visibility into operational costs of their AI workflows—they can't see token consumption, identify resource-intensive agents/stages, or make informed cost/value decisions.

**8 Goals** prioritized (G1-G8): From capturing token data to graceful degradation when unavailable.

**9 Success Criteria** (SC-1 through SC-9): Covering orchestration mode, interactive mode, and robustness requirements.

**Key Constraints**:
- Token data only from Copilot CLI/SDK (no estimation)
- No new dependencies (pure Python)
- Display `n/a` when unavailable (no fabrication)
- Enabled by default (opt-out configuration)

**Critical Dependency**: Feasibility research needed to confirm Copilot CLI/SDK actually exposes token usage in responses.

**Out of Scope**: Dollar cost estimation, dashboards, budget enforcement, real-time display, and third-party integrations.

---

**Exit Criteria Met**: ✅ Clear problem definition with measurable goals
